text:
Samira V.: quick weekly release-train bulletin: two callouts and one policy tweak. please ack and flag any active rollouts.
Yusuf A.: go ahead.
Samira V.: callout 1 — next week's canary windows shift due to inter-region backbone maintenance (apac-east). windows: Mon 2027-01-18 14:00-20:00 UTC and Tue 2027-01-19 02:00-08:00 UTC. plan below.
deploy-bot: maintenance_notice: apac-east backbone maintenance 2027-01-19T02:00:00Z -> 2027-01-19T08:00:00Z. Non-critical ops paused.
Samira V.: callout 2 — stealth rollout for the text-ranking model will start Thu; owners please ensure the PR has the new release.metadata fields (owner, escalation_contact, monitoring_queries). No schema changes in that rollout.
release-czar: policy tweak: effective immediately — mandatory short-form rollback rationale required on all release PRs. one sentence + one rollback command. If missing, scheduler will block.
Alyssa M.: can you paste an example of the one-line rollback rationale?
Samira V.: example to include in PR: "rollback: revert to model v4 by setting model_tag=stable-v4 (cli: rctl rollback --model ranking --tag stable-v4)". keep it short.
QA-bot: reminder: QA will run perf-smoke and functional smoke for any rollout touching serving. attach smoke logs to PR within 30m of deploy completion.
infra-lead: temporary canary caps for maintenance windows: max 2% traffic for model-serving changes; auto-pause if error rate uplifts by >1.7% for a 6m window. forced rollback at 12m if owner does not act. Ops will enforce centrally.
Yusuf A.: paste snippet for the canary config we should put in PRs?
infra-lead: snippet for PR body (code block): ```text
canary.max_percent=2
canary.error_uplift_pct=1.7
canary.window_mins=6
canary.forced_rollback_mins=12
```
Samira V.: scheduling note: release scheduler will block any DB migration that touches routing tables during the maintenance windows. lightweight index-only changes ok with infra signoff.
release-czar: exemption path: open a short RFC in #eng-releases with: owner, justification, rollback one-liner, smoke test name, approver handle. We'll aim to respond within 90 minutes.
Alyssa M.: ACK. I have a model-embed canary at 1.8% traffic; will cap to 1% for the maintenance windows and add the one-line rollback to the PR.
Yusuf A.: ACK. My team has a small client-side config rollout scheduled Tue night; no serving changes, so should be fine.
Samira V.: thanks all. I'll publish a pinned KB in #eng-notices with the checklist and update the release calendar. if you have long-running experiments, drop them here by EOD so we can compile a safe list. :mag_right:
